milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Hay block is at (0, 0, 15) relative to spawn — 15 blocks away, requiring intentional navigation south. Max distance 5 means player must walk ~10 blocks to get close enough. Facing tolerance 60° ensures player is looking at the hay bales.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Rabbit pen center is at (0, 1, 20) relative to spawn. Max distance 5 requires player to walk to the pen area (20 blocks from spawn). Facing tolerance 60° ensures player is looking toward the pen where rabbits wander.

Uses inventory_has because mining jungle_wood (all-bark block placed at x+12) drops itself as the jungle_wood item into inventory when mined with any tool. The scene places minecraft:jungle_wood blocks which drop as jungle_wood.
Uses inventory_has because mining acacia_wood (all-bark block placed at x+15) drops itself as the acacia_wood item into inventory when mined with any tool.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a bow at the crafting table places it into the player's inventory. Recipe: 3 sticks (from wood→planks→sticks) + 3 string (given at start). The crafted bow appears in inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Birch trapdoor is at (-8, 2, 0) relative to spawn, marking the fortress entrance. Max distance 4 requires player to walk right up to the entrance (8 blocks from spawn). Facing tolerance 60° ensures player is looking at the trapdoor.
Uses inventory_has because mining cobblestone_wall with an iron pickaxe drops the cobblestone_wall item into inventory. The wall is at x-10 in the fortress corridor and requires a pickaxe to drop.
Uses inventory_has because mining gray_concrete with an iron pickaxe drops the gray_concrete item into inventory. The wall is at x-12 in the fortress corridor.

Uses inventory_has because mining warped_wart_block with the iron hoe (provided in revised scene) drops the warped_wart_block item into inventory. Critical: this block ONLY drops when mined with a hoe — pickaxe yields nothing. The wall is at x-14.
Uses inventory_has because breaking a red_mushroom drops the red_mushroom item into inventory. Red mushrooms break instantly with any tool or bare hand. Located at x-16 on mycelium.

Uses position_inside_box as a spatial proxy because no available rule type can directly detect splash potion throwing (usage removes it from inventory, making inventory_has fail AFTER use). The arena interior (x-21 to x-18) is only reachable by passing through the potion chest room at x-17 in the linear corridor. Box excludes the chest position to ensure player has moved beyond the pickup point into the arena, implying potion retrieval and progression.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because this is a combat/kill task. The Size:1 slime at (-20, 1, 0) splits into 2-4 Size:0 tiny slimes on death. Setting max_count=3 confirms the original slime was killed (combat completed) — a living Size:1 slime counts as 1, but after death it becomes 2-4 tiny slimes. If max splits (4) occur, player must kill at least 1 tiny slime to reach ≤3. Box generously covers the arena with padding to ensure slime stays inside detection area.
